symptom: ako/mxcli#1862 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1704): no documented MDL form for Data grid 2's emptyPlaceholder. On main `emptyplaceholder { … }` parsed, checked and executed, but mx check (11.14) then reported CE0463 on the grid.
cause: The slot is hidden while showEmptyPlaceholder is 'none' (the default); widgets in a hidden slot are a definition mismatch. Studio Pro's own grid with a placeholder (TestApp WorkflowCommons.ConflictResolution) stores showEmptyPlaceholder 'custom'. MDL-WIDGET10 never saw it because widgetValueMap only counted `key: value` properties as set, not slots filled by child blocks.
file: mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go (widgetValueMap marks filled slots), mdl/executor/validate_widget_hidden.go (filled hidden slot is an error), cmd/mxcli/syntax/features_page.go (documented form)
insight: 'Accepted and round-trips' is not 'works': run mx check on a control page with and without the feature — a plain grid was 0 errors, the same grid plus a placeholder CE0463. Then diff against a Studio Pro-authored instance of the same feature in the fixture (a describe sweep for the keyword finds one) — the difference was a sibling property, not the slot's own BSON.
